messages:
Alex H: Quick heads-up — finalizing release notes for 0.29.2. Need a short internal blurb + pin for Monday 09:00 PT. Can we lock the canary and confirm rollback owners?
Maria C: I can draft the internal blurb. Will keep it 2-3 lines + bullets for user-facing changes.
Devon R: Canary window looks good at 08:00 PT -> 08:30 PT. Plan to watch latency and error rate.
Jen P: Who's owning rollback if the canary shows model regressions? I can be primary for deploy rollback, Samir can handle DB migration fallback.
Samir K: Ack. I'll own DB rollback and feature-flag revert. Add me to the oncall steps.
Alex H: Thanks. Maria — please include a single sentence about the model pinning change (we pin v2.1.4 -> v2.2-beta fallback). Also note the deploybot cue and quiet window.
Maria C: Draft below — LMK edits: 
> Internal: Rolling update to inference pipeline (0.29.2). Pins model to v2.1.4 for prod; introduces canary of v2.2-beta in staging. Canary Monday 08:00 PT, full rollout 09:00 PT if green.
> User-visible: minor latency improvement; no API changes.
Devon R: small nit: change "pins model to v2.1.4 for prod" -> "pins prod to v2.1.4 and enables v2.2-beta in canary"
Maria C: Updated.
Alex H: Nice. Now deploybot run plan. Devon, can you post the exact deploybot commands so ops and oncall can copy?
Devon R: Sure — staging canary command: ```/deploy start --env staging --version 0.29.2 --canary 10% --note "canary v2.2-beta"```
Devon R: Prod rollout command (if canary green): ```/deploy start --env production --version 0.29.2 --pin v2.1.4 --note "pin prod, roll v2.2-beta via canary"```
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued. To confirm run `/deploy confirm 6001112223` within 15m.
oncall-bot: Oncall roster ping: @Jen P is current infra oncall, @Samir K is DB oncall.
Jen P: I'll be watching the canary dashboard and ready to cut the abort if token errors > 1% or latency +50ms p50.
Samir K: DB migration is a separate migration step? We should ensure feature-flag can be toggled without deploy. I'll prepare the revert play.
Alex H: Good call. Maria — include a rollback bullet in the blurb that points to rollback owners + quick commands.
Maria C: Added rollback snippet: 
- If canary fails: abort canary with `/deploy abort --env staging --reason "canary regressions"` and notify #incidents.
- If prod needs rollback: `/deploy rollback --env production --to-version 0.29.1` — primary: Jen P, DB fallback: Samir K.
Devon R: I'll add the smoke-check checklist to the release notes: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, kv-cache hitrate, and model perplexity sanity check.
Alex H: Perfect. Final ask — keep internal announcement short: 1 line + 3 bullets and a link to runbook. Maria, can you drop this in #eng-releases at 08:50 PT and pin until 10:30 PT?
Maria C: Will do. Draft for posting: 
"Deploy Monday 09:00 PT: 0.29.2 (pins prod to v2.1.4). Canary 08:00 PT staging. Primary rollback: Jen P; DB rollback: Samir K. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/0.29.2"
Jen P: LGTM :thumbsup:
Samir K: LGTM.
Alex H: Thanks everyone. I'll confirm the `/deploy confirm` once Maria posts the blurb.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: canary start at 08:00 PT, auto-check at 08:20 PT, confirm window open until 08:40 PT.
